description:
Validate vault files against the schemas directory.

Usage: [PATH ...] [--schemas DIR] [--quiet]

Args:
  PATHS — zero or more files to validate. With none, walks the whole vault.

Flags:
  --schemas directory holding the schema files; defaults to the schemas directory shipped alongside the tool.
  --quiet suppress per-violation output, leaving only the exit code.

Examples:
  []
  ["--quiet"]
  ["notes/2026-05-27-14-30-00.md"]

Notes:
  Violations print as <path>:<line>: <message>.
  Exit 0 clean, 1 if any violations, 2 on a usage or startup failure.
  Read-only; it never rewrites files.
  Run after buffer flush, tasks ingest, or any mutation, before committing.
